run_hand_tracking_evaluation: run the hand tracking evaluation on MP4 videos using a pretrained model and known skeleton
find_input_output_files: find all MP4 input files and their corresponding NPY output paths in a directory tree
track_sequence: track hand keypoints in a video sequence and save results as a pickled numpy array
compute_tracking_error: compute the per-frame mean error between ground truth and tracked hand keypoints
load_pretrained_model: load a pretrained hand tracking model from a torch checkpoint file for evaluation
